basic_info.description: Discover the charm of the North Waterfront, a peaceful enclave between the Embarcadero and Telegraph Hill. Surrounded by lush parks and iconic city landmarks, this park-like neighborhood offers effortless access to Levi's Plaza, the Ferry Building, North Beach, the Financial District, and Fisherman's Wharf, along with vibrant shopping and dining just moments away. Located in the full-service Parc Telegraph Tower, this rear-facing condo enjoys privacy and partial views of Alcatraz and the Bay. The smart roommate-style layout features two ensuite bedrooms, one with a walk-in closet, separated by a spacious open-plan living, dining, and kitchen area. The kitchen is outfitted with granite countertops, a breakfast bar, and newer appliances including an induction cooktop, oven, microwave, and dishwasher.  Additional highlights include, newer in-unit washer/dryer, one-car garage parking, and two storage cages. Residents enjoy premium amenities such as a 24-hour attendant and security, on-site HOA management, secure package room, a well-equipped fitness center, spa, and sauna. Whether you're seeking a tranquil retreat, a stylish city home, or a strong investment opportunity, this condo delivers a rare blend of luxury and convenience in one of SF's most desirable neighborhoods.
